snippet.title: Saros - Zenith Gameplay Reveal | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
This is the gameplay reveal for SAROS™: Zenith, the next big free content update to SAROS, which adds new replayable game modes and various new visual and control options to make the game accessible to even more players.
 
SAROS™: Zenith adds Overlord Rush, a brand new mode where you can take on the powerful Overlord enemies from the main game back-to-back, go for a high score, and compete with players around the world using integrated leaderboards in a throwback to the classic arcade-style Housemarque is known for.
 
This update also brings ""Eclipse Layers"", a new game+ mode which allows seasoned enforcers to put their skills to the ultimate test. After clearing SAROS, players can return to the beginning and take on a more challenging version of the game. You can rise to meet these trials with even more progression options and new Carcosan Modifiers to customize your experience. There are also new secrets and trophies to discover as you delve deeper into the Eclipse Layers.
 
New accessibility features, including High-Contrast visuals, gyro aiming with the DualSense wireless controller, and the toggleable ""Slow Game Speed"" option have been added. With these options, even more players can experience the spectacular bullet-ballet action of SAROS for themselves.
